description: Fixed 22-task human-annotation subset: two tasks from each of the 11 PersonaCUA persona families.

tasks.title: Pieces for a small React art prototype
tasks.rationale: Representative multi-site visual research task with a clear model gap and non-zero results from both models.

tasks.title: Entry path into LA post-production IT
tasks.rationale: A higher-performing career-and-media research task where Muse leads on the four persona cells, balancing the direction of comparison.

tasks.title: Baltimore event night from official pages
tasks.rationale: High-quality official-source browsing trace with a measurable model difference and no all-zero persona cells.

tasks.title: Little free pantries around Chapel Hill
tasks.rationale: Representative local-community errand task with multiple map or listing pages, moderate difficulty, and useful partial-credit decisions.

tasks.title: Family car under $50k near Minneapolis
tasks.rationale: Difficult product-search task with a large Grok-over-Muse gap and several partial or failed traces to annotate.

tasks.title: Accessory shortlist for the household's cars
tasks.rationale: Counterexample where Muse performs better on average, reducing one-sided model comparisons.

tasks.title: Roasted Brussels sprouts recipe and kitchen setup
tasks.rationale: Representative open-web food research task with several independently scorable rubrics and complete traces.

tasks.title: Book a business dinner in Haight-Ashbury
tasks.rationale: REAL restaurant-booking task with a large model gap; pairs a transactional task with the Odysseys food task.

tasks.title: Compare Pilates studios in Clovis
tasks.rationale: Fitness-oriented health task with strong but non-identical model performance, clear schedules and prices, and complete traces.

tasks.title: NYC knee-surgeon shortlist for ACL or meniscus care
tasks.rationale: Health task where Muse performs better on average, useful for testing annotator sensitivity to genuine reverse-direction cases.

tasks.title: Private shared-journaling setup and AI access
tasks.rationale: Privacy-focused open-web comparison with multiple evidence rubrics and a sizable model gap.

tasks.title: Find a Southern California home and book a tour
tasks.rationale: REAL housing transaction task with non-zero outcomes and mixed persona success; gives this scenario both suites.

tasks.title: Write Barbara Thomas an email about the project plan
tasks.rationale: Short transactional email task with a modest model difference and clear state-based rubric.

tasks.title: Delete Wednesday's project sync from the calendar
tasks.rationale: Both models succeed across personas, providing a positive agreement and annotation-calibration task.

tasks.title: Create a Financial Analyst job opening
tasks.rationale: Representative form-heavy TopWork task with a large model gap and clear completion state.

tasks.title: Connect with three new people
tasks.rationale: NetworkIn task where Muse performs better on average, covering a second professional application and reverse-direction outcome.

tasks.title: Reading-support mini lesson for fifth grade
tasks.rationale: Multi-source education task with a large model gap and useful partial-rubric variation.

tasks.title: Beginner AI explainer from IBM to hardware
tasks.rationale: Matched high-performing task that serves as an agreement anchor and broadens subject matter.

tasks.title: Small subscription budget: Patreon versus ChatGPT
tasks.rationale: High-performing technology comparison with a consistent Grok advantage and several observable evidence steps.

tasks.title: Chromebook notes for Firefox and Apple passwords
tasks.rationale: Technology task where Muse performs better, balancing direction of disagreement within the scenario.

tasks.title: Chicago to Aurora transit outing
tasks.rationale: Representative transit-and-weather planning task where both models achieve substantial partial credit with concise complete traces.

tasks.title: Book an XL ride from 388 Beale to Amber Indian
tasks.rationale: REAL ride-booking task where Muse leads strongly, balancing model direction while giving travel one task from each suite.
